stories.new_fact: Judge Carl Nichols issued a preliminary injunction blocking USPS implementation of the mail-ballot rule after a related Boston order was already before the Supreme Court.
stories.new_takeaway: Election administrators now have a timing reprieve, but the Supreme Court can still alter live ballot-preparation work.
stories.why_now: Mail ballots are already being sent in several states and more states are preparing distribution this week.
stories.previous_coverage: The September 12 episode covered the first court/Supreme Court setup; this adds a second judge and separate injunction.
stories.uncertainty: The Supreme Court's action could leave, narrow, or lift the freeze.
stories.watch: Watch whether the Supreme Court acts before more states mail ballots.

stories.new_fact: Amazon paused operations with 21 Air after the September 6 crash of Flight 7598 in Miami.
stories.new_takeaway: The crash is now also a vendor-risk and customer-control story, not only an accident investigation.
stories.why_now: Amazon's pause was reported Sunday as the NTSB investigation continued.
stories.previous_coverage: The September 7 episode covered the crash investigation; it did not have Amazon's operational response.
stories.uncertainty: The NTSB has not issued a probable cause or full cockpit transcript.
stories.watch: Watch whether Amazon makes the pause permanent or adds new operating conditions.

stories.new_fact: Axios connected the Acton case with Bexley and Upper Arlington examples and broader threat data for public officials.
stories.new_takeaway: Central Ohio officials face a public-access and security tradeoff, not just a campaign-incident story.
stories.why_now: The local analysis was published September 14 after Havas' plea and release on bond.
stories.previous_coverage: No recent episode used public-official threat data as the local angle.
stories.uncertainty: It is unclear whether local officials will change public-event protocols.
stories.watch: Watch whether campaigns or local governments announce new event-security practices.

stories.new_fact: WSJ reported more than 40% of unpaid mortgage balances had rates of 5% or higher as of July.
stories.new_takeaway: A future rate drop would activate more refinance and servicing-retention work than the old low-rate lock-in story implied.
stories.why_now: The WSJ mortgage-bond risk piece published September 14 against fresh seven-percent daily rate pressure.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent episodes covered lock-desk pressure and GSE score-model plumbing; this rotates to servicing and MBS prepayment risk.
stories.uncertainty: If Treasury yields remain high, many refinance options stay out of the money.
stories.watch: Watch post-Fed daily mortgage pricing for a retreat that activates retention triggers.

stories.new_fact: The ledger added Pockit's AI customer-support deployment with a disclosed 70%+ resolution rate and 80% CSAT on AI-handled inbound support.
stories.new_takeaway: The implementation lesson is to judge servicing AI by resolved customer outcomes and handoff boundaries, not ticket closure alone.
stories.why_now: Weekly implementation-source recheck found a previously uncovered, source-readable customer disclosure.
stories.previous_coverage: Not covered in the prior seven episodes; previous bank-AI stories focused on Rogo, FIS/Anthropic, Truist, Better, and OpenAI financial services.
stories.uncertainty: The evidence is vendor-hosted customer disclosure, not an independent audit or regulator report.
stories.watch: Watch for a named bank or fintech publishing repeat-contact, complaint, or cost-per-contact results.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Added Pockit / Gradient Labs, lane 1 consumer servicing and contact center, production/customer-disclosure row.

stories.new_fact: China's Foreign Ministry criticized Amodei's call for continued U.S. restrictions on advanced AI chips and chipmaking equipment to China.
stories.new_takeaway: The frontier AI slowdown debate has moved into U.S.-China governance and export-control positioning ahead of a September 24 meeting.
stories.why_now: The Chinese response came Monday after Amodei's Saturday essay and Trump's Sunday comments.
stories.previous_coverage: The September 13 episode covered the slowdown debate; this is one of the allowed carryovers with a new diplomatic development.
stories.uncertainty: No independent test settles the agent-risk claims cited in the debate, and the summit may produce no binding mechanism.
stories.watch: Watch the September 24 Trump-Xi meeting for export-control, evaluation-access, or governance language.
stories.frontier_bar: Policy that binds labs directly, with safety/security and infrastructure implications.
